description: Decision gate: the agent captures trade-offs, records the choice, and asks only when the contract is genuinely missing.

scenarios.context: The agent faces a design decision with clear trade-offs (performance vs. readability, DRY vs. clarity). The user did not specify a preference.

criteria.description: The agent must state the trade-offs it considered before making the decision.
The agent must record the choice it made and why.

scenarios.expectation: The bifurcation is logged via tracer.logTechnicalDecision with decisionPoint, rationale, alternatives, evidence and technicalMetrics before any implementation.

scenarios.context: The agent encounters a requirement that is genuinely missing from the contract (no spec, no prior decision, no reasonable default). The agent must ask.

criteria.description: The agent must ask when the contract is genuinely missing, not just ambiguous.
The agent must not fabricate a requirement when the contract is missing.

scenarios.expectation: Missing-contract situations are escalated; implementation is held until a decision record with at least two compared alternatives and per-alternative evidence is registered.
